name: Fast Wavelet Transform (FWT)
aliases: Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) using Haar basis
definition: The discrete wavelet transform projects a function $f$ onto integer scalings and translations of the wavelet function. The FWT algorithm efficiently computes these coefficients by exploiting the hierarchical MRA structure.
summary: The Fast Wavelet Transform efficiently computes discrete wavelet decomposition using filter banks and downsampling, reducing complexity to linear time compared to direct computation.
